answer_1.quote: Evaluation of open-domain dialogue is particularly challenging and has been cited in high-profile competitions as a known open problem.

answer_2.quote: We compute the correlation between commonly applied automatic metrics and our human evaluation methods, including word-overlap-based metrics and reference-free metrics

answer_3.quote: USR (an UnSupervised Reference-free metric) uses the pre-trained model RoBERTa to assess the quality of a conversation.
methods: automatic scoring using pre-trained models for metrics FED and USR

answer_4.quote: we present a new method of open-domain dialogue evaluation based on human assessment of live conversations
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate conversations on a 0-100 scale under seven measurement criteria: Robotic, Interesting, Fun, Consistent, Fluent, Repetitive, and Topic.
